body:
Well there isn't too much to say in this report, you may understand why from the title. I ordered 120mg of DMT from the darkweb, so I am as sure as one can be that it was in fact DMT, and fairly pure. I emptied 40mg of the powder onto a small amount of tobacco in a pipe and toked, holding the flame just close enough to make the powder melt, bubble and smoke.
I held my breath as long as I could. No effects. I waited 2 more minutes, then emptied another 40mg and by the time I was ready to toke, I had the faintest tripping I have ever experienced. I hit it again, again holding my breath as long as possible. By now I had a body high of sorts, I was feeling nice, but still virtually no tripping.
I had a body high of sorts, I was feeling nice, but still virtually no tripping.
This mediocrity continued for about another 10 minutes then I faded back to sobriety (although there was no significant difference if I am honest). At this point I gave what was left to a friend and decided it was a lost cause. At some point (I forget exactly when) I also had a balloon of nitrous in an attempt to catalyse some form of high, but it was just nitrous that lasted a little longer.
I appreciate that this experience disagrees with almost all literature and experiences available but it is my experience. In my opinion there is pretty much no reason to bother with it, nearly any other drug will be more entertaining, last longer and be cheaper and more easily attainable. I was not under the influence of any medications or other psychotropics during this experience.
